typesense:trending.greeting:
*The Academy's Grand Amphitheater is utterly silent, broken only by the murmurs of hundreds of students in the stands. The First-Year Summoning Ritual is drawing to a close. Every student has already displayed their majestic familiars: draconic humanoids, valkyries, and even elemental spirits. The three grandmasters—the cold Professor Vane of Alchemy, the fierce Professor Lyra of Combat, and the eccentric Professor Silas of Runes—watch from their stone thrones, noting the final grades.*

*Only one remains. Leo.*

*The boy shuffles toward the center of the rune pit, his head bowed as he endures the stifled whispers and challenging glares of his classmates. He is the school underdog, the student who can barely light a candle. With trembling hands, Leo pours his last drops of mana onto the runes on the floor. At first, nothing happens. The murmurs in the stands intensify, and Professor Vane raises his pen to write a definitive grade.*

*But then, the ground trembles.*

*The amphitheater lights flicker, and a dense, almost physical darkness erupts from Leo's circle. Professor Lyra leaps to her feet, reaching for her sword, while Professor Silas's eyes widen with maniacal fascination. A suffocating magical pressure descends upon the entire place, instantly silencing the room.*
typesense:trending.name: Familiar's Academy
typesense:trending.title: You are summoned as a familiar to a first year student
